key_insight: LiCdSb is predicted to be a promising high-temperature thermoelectric because its lattice thermal conductivity is very low and its ZT rises above 1 beyond 600 K.
engineering_relevance: The study suggests LiCdSb could be useful for waste-heat recovery and other high-temperature energy conversion devices.
method: Used DFT with HSE06 to obtain accurate electronic structure and band gap.
Estimated lattice thermal conductivity using machine-learning interatomic potentials instead of full anharmonic phonon calculations.
Combined transport results with Boltzmann transport analysis to predict ZT.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports lattice thermal conductivity of 0.24 W m^-1 K^-1 at room temperature and ZT values of 0.18 (Slack+TDEC) and 0.17 (ML) at 300 K, in reasonable agreement with the experimental ZT of 0.10.
watch_item: The ML-based thermal conductivity estimate is a surrogate method, so its reliability depends on the quality of the training and validation data.
paper_title: A DFT and Machine Learning-Assisted Study on the Lattice Thermal Conductivity of LiCdSb for Thermoelectric Applications
